text:
abby (PM): Quick design sync: uploaded a compact-playground frame focused on streaming controls + token counter. fig: https://www.figma.com/file/redwood/compact-playground-streaming (see micro + collapsed states)

maria (Design): Main nits: token counter is visually noisy in collapsed state and the stop icon sits too close to message actions. Thinking: show `~N` while streaming, exact on finish; and a 1px divider between counter & actions.

sam (Eng): Agree on `~N`. Implementation: cheap estimator = ceil(chars/4). We'll emit server final count on completion. Avoid full tokenization per chunk.

jia (DevEx): Accessibility: visual tilde okay but SRs should get "approximately N tokens" via aria-label. Add an aria-live polite region (throttled to 300ms) that says "Streaming, approx N tokens" and final "Generation complete  final token count: N". Also ensure Esc to interrupt and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter to regenerate.

maria (Design): Copy options in fig comments: "Interrupt (Esc)" vs "Pause (Esc)". Prototype includes both; will run a quick preference test. Also updated swatches to meet 4.5:1 contrast.

abby (PM): Mobile: long-press bubble to surface interrupt/regenerate; show one-time hint toast. For screen readers register an accessible action on the bubble.

sam (Eng): Small dev note: when regenerate mid-stream, crossfade to new response to avoid jank; keep KV cache unless user clears. I'll add a slim PR with estimator + hotkeys + aria attributes.

preview-bot: Preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/compact-playground/1755554321  please test keyboard and VoiceOver flows.

jia (DevEx): I'll add a short checklist to the PR: aria-live snippet, visual `~N` -> aria reads "approximately N tokens", throttle 300ms, Esc interrupt, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter regenerate, long-press hint on mobile.

abby (PM): Target merge tomorrow. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
